findings.current: The problem was that he had a dark blue bruise on his face from getting beaten by me that morning, so there was no way he could come along.
findings.defect: The translation omits the narrator’s ironic 덕분에 (“thanks to”), weakening the comic self-awareness that he personally caused Hyuk Mujin’s condition.
findings.rationale: 덕분에 deliberately frames the consequence of the narrator’s own beating as something Hyuk Mujin has to ‘thank’ him for.
findings.replacement: The problem was that, thanks to the beating I’d given him that morning, he had a dark blue bruise on his face and couldn’t possibly come along.

findings.current: The Deputy Military Commissioner was a second-rank official, with only two such posts in each province.
findings.defect: 종이품 specifically denotes the junior second rank, not the second rank generically.
findings.rationale: The omitted junior/senior subdivision is a concrete detail of the official hierarchy.
findings.replacement: The Deputy Military Commissioner was a junior second-rank official, with only two such posts in each province.

findings.defect: The blunt imperative loses the deliberately deferential register of 하문하십시오 while Li Feng continues observing formal hierarchy toward his political superior.
findings.rationale: 하문하십시오 is an honorific invitation for a superior to pose his question; the current wording sounds curt and commanding.

summary: The chapter is highly faithful overall, with three minor fidelity defects involving irony, official rank, and deferential register.
